title: [inductor][estimations] Support sparsity_hint for flex_attention flop estimates
body:
Stack from [ghstack](https://github.com/ezyang/ghstack/tree/0.14.0) (oldest at bottom):
* (to be filled)

flex_attention with sparse masks (e.g., causal, block-sparse) does
significantly fewer FLOPs than the dense O(N^2) upper bound. This
causes the roofline cost model to overestimate compute time, which
in turn skews overlap scheduling and SAC decisions.

This PR threads a `sparsity_hint` annotation (0.0-1.0 fraction of
skipped work) from `torch.fx.traceback.annotate` through the flop
counting infrastructure so that flex_attention forward and backward
flop formulas can scale down their estimates accordingly.

The plumbing:
- `get_compute_time` accepts an optional `node_meta` dict, forwarded
  as `_node_meta` kwarg to flop formulas
- `estimate_roofline_runtime_ms` passes `node.meta` through
- flex_attention flop formulas read `sparsity_hint` from `_node_meta`
- `FlexAttentionAutogradOp` captures `sparsity_hint` in forward and
  re-annotates the backward call so both directions benefit

Authored with Claude.
